candidates.description: Two male specimens (the types) of the "Antioquia Myiopagis"'. It sounds quite like M. olallai, check it out in xeno-canto, but it is decidedly distinct in multiple traits from topotypical M. olallai from Ecuador. Paul Coopmans would have liked to see this bird. We describe it in the Oct 14th (2014)
